note: Words for what a product is, as a person would feel it. They choose which typeface classes are offered for the name (see fonts.json, psychology.classes). Weigh only the traits that genuinely apply.

heritage.means: tradition, craft, history, myth, things that last

functional.means: bought for what it does: tools, software, finance, utilities

sensory-social.means: bought for how it feels or what it says about you: food, fashion, leisure, community

both.means: does a job and is also an experience
